notes: The game is now completely silent when it loses focus: tab switch, minimised window, phone lock and the Windows and Android apps' own window focus. Sound returns once, at your saved volumes.
Music leads the mix: engine and effects sit underneath and the default Environment level is much lower. Deliberate volume choices you made are kept.
Settings now explain every volume slider; Mute music and Mute all remain independent.
New launch page with routes, garage, weather, soundtrack, downloads with checksums, controls and community.
Join-the-team interest form, feedback and bug-report links, and a GitHub star link.
Voluntary support screen (menu, Settings, About). Support channels are still being verified: nothing to pay yet, nothing unlocked by it, ever.
Android update installs over beta.1: same signing key, higher version code.
